notes: A project name stays reserved after archive+delete; re-creating with the same name returns 'Project with this name already exists' — retry with a distinct name.
DELETE of an ACTIVE project is rejected — archive first (archive is a replace-PUT via updateProject: GET, carry fields, overlay archived:true, then DELETE).
Reading a deleted project returns 400 code 501, byte-identical to a never-existing id — the wire cannot distinguish deleted / never existed / other workspace.
Deleted, never-existing, and foreign-workspace ids all return the same 400 code 501 body ('Project doesn't belong to Workspace'), never 404.
Omitting `archived` returns archived AND active rows; only archived=false restricts to active.
Last-Page response header is authoritative for pagination; bare array.
